title: DEMA Phase 1 Business Runtime Readiness Proposal
scope: Readiness gate and recommendation for eight business candidates; this artifact is not provisioning and does not assert runtime readiness.

candidate_entries.purpose: Public entry point that receives a user request, applies routing boundaries, and hands work to approved DEMA capabilities.

proposed_provider_model_policy.selection_rule: Use only a model present in the verified provider/model catalog after the provider and model decision is approved.

candidate_entries.permission_boundary: Tenant-scoped request intake and routing only; no cross-tenant access, roster mutation, runtime activation, or unapproved external action.

candidate_entries.purpose: Coordinates approved domain work, preserves human approval boundaries, and returns a bounded result to the entry point.

proposed_provider_model_policy.selection_rule: Use only a model present in the verified provider/model catalog after the provider and model decision is approved.

candidate_entries.permission_boundary: Coordinates only within the requesting tenant and approved capability graph; cannot activate candidates or change platform configuration.

candidate_entries.purpose: Handles bounded support intake, triage, and response drafting using approved support knowledge.

proposed_provider_model_policy.selection_rule: Select a verified provider/model only after the support persona and tool contract are approved.

candidate_entries.permission_boundary: May read approved support knowledge for the requesting tenant and draft responses; no customer-record mutation or external send without approval.

candidate_entries.purpose: Supports bounded lead qualification, sales research, and draft follow-up within an approved tenant boundary.

proposed_provider_model_policy.selection_rule: Select a verified provider/model only after sales persona, tool, and data-use decisions are approved.

candidate_entries.permission_boundary: May work with approved tenant sales context and draft outputs; no CRM write, outreach, or pricing commitment without approval.

candidate_entries.purpose: Proposes bounded CRM lookup, record summarization, and next-action drafts without assuming write access.

proposed_provider_model_policy.selection_rule: Select a verified provider/model only after CRM data boundary and tool contract are approved.

candidate_entries.permission_boundary: Read-only proposal boundary for approved tenant CRM context; no record mutation, export, or cross-tenant lookup.

candidate_entries.purpose: Owns the proposed commerce domain boundary and coordinates bounded order and booking workflows.

candidate_entries.purpose: Bounded commerce workflow for booking intake, availability questions, and human-review handoff under DEMA Commerce.

proposed_provider_model_policy.selection_rule: Shares the approved Commerce runtime owner initially; it is not a separate top-level runtime candidate.

dependencies.description: Select a provider and exact model from a verified catalog; no candidate receives a model assignment in this proposal.
Approve each candidate persona, input contract, output contract, escalation rule, and human handoff behavior.
Define and approve the bounded tool surface, read/write behavior, failure modes, and external-action confirmation rules.
Approve tenant-scoped knowledge sources, retrieval limits, provenance requirements, and separation from platform-internal context.
Demonstrate caller-to-tenant mapping and prevent cross-tenant reads, writes, memory access, and workflow leakage.
Run a bounded on-demand smoke with synthetic or approved fixture data and no live business action.
Set cost, token, rate, and concurrency limits with an observable refusal path before user approval.
Define auditable decision, handoff, tool, approval, and failure events without recording sensitive values.
Obtain explicit product and rollout approval for the candidate set, runtime ownership, permissions, and user exposure.

acceptance_gates.description: Exact provider/model policy is selected and recorded from the verified catalog.
acceptance_gates.evidence: Approved decision record and a non-secret exact model reference.

acceptance_gates.description: Persona and input/output contracts are reviewed for every proposed runtime owner and workflow.
acceptance_gates.evidence: Reviewed contract notes with escalation and refusal behavior.

acceptance_gates.description: Tool names, scopes, confirmation requirements, and error handling are bounded and tested.
acceptance_gates.evidence: Tool contract and negative-path test results.

acceptance_gates.description: Knowledge scope is approved and cannot cross tenant or platform boundaries.
acceptance_gates.evidence: Scope matrix and isolation test results.

acceptance_gates.description: Two-tenant read and write checks show that one tenant cannot access another tenant's context.
Each approved runtime owner passes a bounded on-demand smoke without live business side effects.
acceptance_gates.evidence: Reproducible smoke command and output using approved fixtures.

acceptance_gates.description: Budget, rate, token, and concurrency behavior is configured and refusal is observable.
acceptance_gates.evidence: Quota configuration review and limit tests.

acceptance_gates.description: Required lifecycle, approval, handoff, and tool events are auditable without sensitive values.
acceptance_gates.evidence: Audit event schema and redaction checks.

acceptance_gates.description: A human approves product scope, runtime roster recommendation, permission boundary, and release target.
acceptance_gates.evidence: Explicit approval record for the next rollout step.

dema-order.reason: Order is a bounded commerce workflow and shares the Commerce lifecycle initially.

dema-booking.reason: Booking is a bounded commerce workflow and shares the Commerce lifecycle initially.

non_goals: roster mutation: do not add, remove, or edit existing entries in agents.json.
autonomous runtime: do not create a scheduler, cron, profile, persistent MCP configuration, or autonomous business process.
public release: do not expose these candidates to public or multi-user traffic.
personal-agent provisioning: do not create tenant users, personal agents, or private workspaces.
live business execution: do not send messages, mutate orders, create bookings, or perform external business actions.
frontend or API expansion: do not add a dashboard route or UI for this readiness artifact.

proposed_runtime_roster.notes: This recommendation does not create runtime identities and must receive a separate rollout approval before any provisioning decision.
